description: This historical aerial archive preserves about 34,000 photographs of northern and central Ethiopia taken during 1935–1941. Ghent University and partners organise the material into 8,281 assemblages, with roughly 40 percent relocated geographically. PANGAEA supplies an openly downloadable TSV index under CC-BY-4.0, while the project website offers high-resolution digitised images free on request through its map. The index’s own dated subset spans November 1935 to January 1940, not the full archive period. The imagery can reconstruct past settlement, vegetation and catchment conditions for land-change and infrastructure-exposure simulations. It complements modern satellite imagery by extending visual evidence into the pre-satellite period. Many images are oblique or lack fiducial marks, so orthorectification and location checks are needed before measurement. The index licence does not establish image-specific reuse terms. No images were requested or downloaded, and scan file formats and complete geographic positioning were not verified.
